kadane :: [Int] -> Int
kadane xs = snd $ foldl' (\(maxSoFar, maxEndingHere) x -> 
    let maxEndingHere' = max x (maxEndingHere + x)
        maxSoFar' = max maxSoFar maxEndingHere'
    in (maxSoFar', maxEndingHere')) (0, 0) xs
